funding.value: Graduate assistantships of $18,000-$30,000 are awarded on a competitive basis, and every PhD student must serve as a teaching assistant for at least two semesters.
funding.quote: Graduate assistantships are available ($18,000-$30,000) on a competitive basis

also.quote: All Ph.D. students are required to serve as teaching assistants for a minimum of two semesters

deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is February 1 (the year is not printed, so the 2026/27 cycle applies), with a final deadline of July 15; graduate assistantship consideration uses the February 1 date.
deadline.quote: Priority Deadline: February 1 | Final Deadline: July 15

gre_subject.value: The Physics page does not say whether the Physics subject GRE is considered.

supervisor.value: The Physics page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

entry_route.value: Doctoral applicants may enter with either an undergraduate degree or a master's in physics.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the doctoral program will be considered with either an undergraduate or master's degree in physics

app_fee.value: The Physics catalog entry lists a $40 non-refundable application fee, above the Graduate School's $38.

toefl_min.value: The Physics catalog entry sets a TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 for applicants without an exempt degree.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 79 on the Internet-Based TOEFL (iBT)

ielts_min.value: The Physics catalog entry sets an IELTS Academic minimum of 6.0 overall.
